task.title: Check entered records against the source
task.brief: Take about 15 minutes. Below are 6 records from source forms and how they were entered. Compare them line by line. Write: (1) each mistake, with the record number and field; (2) the correct value, or what you would do if the source itself is unclear; and (3) one short line for your supervisor about anything that needs checking. A good answer finds every mismatch, doesn't guess unclear data, and is easy to read.
key_points: Record 1: amount digits swapped, should be 4,536
Record 2: day and month swapped, should be 05/09/2026
Record 3: amount has an extra zero, should be 800; name should be D'Souza
Record 4: a digit was added to a 9-digit number; flag it, don't guess
Record 6: PIN was guessed as 380001; flag the 5-digit PIN for checking
A short note to the supervisor on records 4 and 6

rubric.label: Mistakes found
rubric.guide: 0 = few mistakes found, 3 = about half found, 5 = every mismatch found and record 5 left as correct

rubric.label: Unclear data
rubric.guide: 0 = guesses values, 3 = flags one unclear item, 5 = flags both unclear source items and does not guess

rubric.label: Clarity
rubric.guide: 0 = hard to follow, 3 = list given but untidy, 5 = record, field and fix are clear for each item, with a short note
